operator: Technische Werke Schussental GmbH & Co. KG

officialEvidence.currentNetworkEvidence: TWS states it operates about 150 public charging points in Ravensburg, Weingarten and the surrounding Schussental area and that its infrastructure can also be used without a TWS charging card.
officialEvidence.directPayment: Official/current sources confirm ad-hoc activation by QR code and, depending on site, credit/debit card; TWS/Ravensburg explicitly says ad-hoc prices without a charging-card contract are shown at the individual charging station.

identityEvidence.policy: Observed station identity is retained as supporting evidence; no tariff is inferred from the prefix.

pricingEvidence.thirdPartyDiscovery: Current discovery data for sample DE*TWS EVSEs confirms ad-hoc availability but does not expose the direct price; no value is promoted.

decision: Keep partial/fail-closed. Ad-hoc is officially confirmed but exact current direct price is explicitly station-specific and not exposed in the public operator pages checked.
neededToClose: Capture operator-controlled QR/direct-payment payloads or tariff screens for the current DE*TWS EVSE population (at minimum representative AC and DC families), then attach exact prices at station/EVSE scope.
